question: Can you help me calculate the average number of new unicorn companies per year in the top industry from 2019 to 2021?
sql:
-- Calculate average number of new unicorn companies per year in Fintech from 2019-2021
WITH distinct_dates AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT company_id, date_joined, year_founded
    FROM companies_dates
),
distinct_funding AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT company_id, valuation, funding, select_investors
    FROM companies_funding
),
distinct_industries AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT company_id, industry
    FROM companies_industries
),
yearly_counts AS (
    SELECT CAST(substr(dd.date_joined, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) as year_joined, COUNT(*) as unicorn_count
    FROM distinct_dates dd
    JOIN distinct_funding df ON dd.company_id = df.company_id
    JOIN distinct_industries di ON dd.company_id = di.company_id
    WHERE df.valuation >= 1000000000
      AND di.industry = 'Fintech'
      AND CAST(substr(dd.date_joined, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 2019 AND 2021
    GROUP BY year_joined
)
SELECT ROUND(1.0 * SUM(unicorn_count) / 3, 2) as avg_new_unicorns_per_year
FROM yearly_counts
